title: BPP mandate_derive request (DESIGN.md §10.1, §10.2, §14.8; registry R15 participant)
description: Mutation (meta required). Prepares one child Mandate as a mechanical subset of every parent (§10.2): no new operation, resource, data class, destination, participant class, or manifestation; no later deadline or expiry; no larger budget, concurrency, use count, output size, disclosure, or retention ceiling; no greater delegation depth or fanout; no weaker security, evidence, review, or classification requirement; purpose restricted to the parent purpose and current Pledge lineage. The exact parent is pinned by parent_mandate_ref/parent_mandate_revision/parent_mandate_digest (R15 fence: parent revisions); an absent child selector field carries the parent's set unchanged — never wider (gap note G33). Budget is reserved from the parent atomically; incomparable classification or policy domains block derivation; human non-delegable powers never appear in a child; a widening attempt fails the typed authority_widening problem (§14.9) — the never-widening comparison is a kernel rule the schema cannot express. Stage-capable (R15).

allowed_operations.description: Absent carries the parent's set unchanged; present must be a subset (§10.2, gap note G33).

resource_selectors.description: Absent carries the parent's set unchanged; present must be a subset (§10.2, gap note G33).

data_class_selectors.description: Absent carries the parent's set unchanged; present must be a subset (§10.2, gap note G33).

destination_selectors.description: Absent carries the parent's set unchanged; present must be a subset (§10.2, gap note G33).

manifestation_selector.description: Opaque body pending the BPA-1 policy-algebra slice (ADR-0001); gap note G10.

pledge_ref.description: Purpose restricted to the parent purpose and current Pledge lineage (§10.2).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

class.description: Digest class per the §14.2 table; substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_id.description: Key id for keyed classes (raw HMAC keys and per-object salts are never part of a DigestRef).

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef (§14.2): every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash.

mutationMeta.description: MutationMeta (§14.2). Required on every mutation; update operations additionally supply expected_revision (registry rule enforced in code, not expressible here).

grantee_selectors.description: Identifier array referencing selector definitions (gap note G10/G31).

delegation.description: Verbatim §10.1 delegation ceiling; a child Mandate can never exceed it (§10.2).
